body.p: With regard to the restriction requirement between Groups 1-11, Applicants have elected to proceed with Group II invention. This election is made with traverse for the reasons outlined below.

On page 3 of the Restriction Requirement, the Examiner states that even though Groups I and II both require the technical feature of an apparatus comprising an imager, a reference element, and a processor, this technical feature is not a special technical feature because as it does not make a contribution over the prior art in view of DeBusschere (US 20170296119 Al). On page 4, the Examiner points to various paragraphs of DeBusschere as disclosing each element of the technical feature.

Although the Examiner identifies paragraph 61 of DeBusschere as disclosing the reference element, the Applicant finds that this paragraph is completely silent with regard a physical, structural reference element, as required by claims 1 and 47. In view of the absence of any disclosure or teaching of a reference element in DeBusschere, it is respectfully submitted that the restriction is improper, and the Applicant kindly requests the withdrawal of the restriction requirement.

Applicants have also made amendments to the claims as indicated above. Entry of these amendments is respectfully requested. It is respectfully submitted that all the amendments made herein are supported by the application as originally filed, and that no new matter has been added by the amendments. Claim 47 has been amended to replace the phrase "a suprastemal notch" with the phrase "an anatomic location on a torso of the patient". The phrase "an anatomic location on a torso of the patient" is supported, for example, in claim 1 as originally filed. Claims 49 and 51, 63 and 64 have
